Graphical Multiple Comparison Tool

Source: R/alphagraph-package.R
alphagraph-package.Rd

A Shiny interface for designing and analyzing graphical multiple comparison procedures using the graphicalMCP engine.

Details

The namespace retains the historical export pattern for compatibility. Imports are declared with Roxygen tags alongside their implementation.
